email.body1:
Aubri, saw Qualia expand Connect into a branded multi-channel platform and add Axos to the Bank Partner Network.

Growing a partner network usually opens more co-sell targets than a team can personally cover, and partner-sourced pipeline coverage is where it quietly slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across a partner ecosystem on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Qualia's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Aubri, quick follow-up for Qualia.

As the Bank Partner Network grows, the hard part is covering every co-sell and enterprise target with personalized outreach at scale. That is exactly where partner-sourced pipeline stalls.

email.body3:
Aubri, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to similar real estate and fintech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Aubri, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Growing a partner network is its own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays for your partner motion? I'll tailor it to Qualia either way.
